name: Template B: Routine Extension of Approval (EoA) - Self-Disclosure Stream
aphSourceReference: Approval Process Handbook 2024–2027 Chapter II, Clause 2.4
description: Streamlined approval workflow for accredited, zero-deficiency existing technical institutions seeking annual Extension of Approval based on certified self-disclosure, bypassing physical inspection unless flagged.
statutoryConstraints: Permitted solely for institutions holding continuous accreditation and zero pending compliance violations
Random 5% audit sampling may re-route application into full SCRUTINY stage
No change in site, intake expansion, or new course additions allowed under this routine workflow
